references.inspection: Individually inspected full opposite valley elevation: central stepped tower, lower perpendicular Rundle wing, long guest wings, stacked shed dormers, end pavilions and stone window rhythms. Winter snow reduces fine surface evidence.
references.use: Geometry reference only; no photograph pixels embedded.

sources.title: Parks Canada Banff Springs Hotel heritage designation
sources.inspection: Read architectural description: eleven-storey 1911–1914 tower, 1927–1928 replacement main block, dark local Rundle stone, steep copper roofs, shed dormers, round arches and two-tiered gables.

sources.title: Fairmont Your Key to the Castle hotel map, conference-hosted copy
sources.inspection: Read two pages and inspected floor-plan page: north Cascade and south Alhambra end blocks, east Rundle cross-wing, central guest core, later Gatehouse/conference complex and narrow southern connector. Official hotel PDF link returned 404.
